from.place: Normalization of the derived reduction counit and completion unit on resolving complexes

title: Derived reduction model data and normalized complex comparisons
statement: Let B and C be abelian categories with derived categories, F : B → C an additive functor, and P a predicate on B-valued cochain complexes. DerivedReductionModelData records a total left derived functor of F, its homotopy-category counit, its universal property, and invertibility of that counit on P. The complex counit includes the canonical complex-to-homotopy-to-derived comparison isomorphisms. For an additive L : C → B, a functor RF : D(C) → D(B), a homotopy comparison δ from L to RF and an ordinary unit u : id → F ⋙ L, define the normalized unit on a P-complex K as Q(u_K), followed by the normalized δ on F(K), followed by RF of the inverse complex counit. For the completed adic tower [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], bundle the already chosen universal derived pair without changing either chosen functor or counit. This is a record and normalization interface, not an additional existence assertion.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 0941, derived functors and their normalized comparisons

proof.text: Bundle the functor, counit, universal property and computation law from the given existential pair, using exactly its existing two choices. Compose the canonical localization isomorphisms with the counit to obtain the complex comparison. On a resolving complex, all four factors are invertible; typeclass composition proves invertibility. Define the normalized right-derived comparison with its four localization factors and compose it with the ordinary unit and inverse left-derived counit. Specialize to the existing completedAdicReduction_exists pair; unfolding the record projections recovers the original definitions.
